caption: The drawing features a single metallic bucket as its central object, depicted with a large, curved handle extending above the bucket and forming a heart-like shape at the top center. The bucket is drawn in shades of black and grey, giving it a three-dimensional appearance with darker shading on the lower areas to suggest depth and material texture. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or designs. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, rectangular inset illustration that shows a close-up detail of the bucket's handle attachment, outlined in a darker tone and displaying the rivets. The entire drawing is outlined by a thin border, and the name "FRANCIS LAW DURAND" is written in uppercase letters at the bottom right of the main image.
title: Kettle
